examples.text_en: The musicologist wrote a long book about old songs.
examples.text_zh: 这位音乐学者写了一本关于老歌的书。

examples.text_en: She is a musicologist and studies the history of music.
examples.text_zh: 她是一位音乐学者，研究音乐的历史。

examples.text_en: The old man kept a musket in his house.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人把一把火枪留在家里。

examples.text_en: They found a musket near the wall of the school.
examples.text_zh: 他们在学校墙边发现了一把火枪。

examples.text_en: The old room was dark and musty all year.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧房间整年又暗又发霉。

examples.text_en: This food is musty and we will not eat it.
examples.text_zh: 这食物有霉味，我们不会吃它。

examples.text_en: A mutation can change the form of the body.
examples.text_zh: 突变能改变身体的形态。

examples.text_en: These small changes are a kind of mutation.
examples.text_zh: 这些小变化是一种突变。

examples.text_en: The music was muted during the whole meeting.
examples.text_zh: 整场会议期间，音乐都很柔和。

examples.text_en: His voice became muted as the night went on.
examples.text_zh: 随着夜色渐深，他的声音变弱了。

examples.text_en: The mutineer was put in a small dark room.
examples.text_zh: 那个反抗者被关进一间又小又暗的屋子。

examples.text_en: They called him a mutineer and took his money.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他为反抗者，还拿走了他的钱。

examples.text_en: The mutinous group would not follow the law.
examples.text_zh: 这个暴动的群体不肯遵守法律。

examples.text_en: His words were mutinous and the king would not listen.
examples.text_zh: 他的话带有反抗意味，国王不肯听。

examples.text_en: We had mutton and water at the long table.
examples.text_zh: 我们在长桌边吃了羊肉，喝了水。

examples.text_en: The mutton was old but still very good.
examples.text_zh: 这羊肉很老，但仍然很好。

examples.text_en: After the long night he felt muzzy and lost.
examples.text_zh: 熬过漫长的一夜，他感到头脑发昏、茫然。

examples.text_en: Her words were muzzy and hard to follow.
examples.text_zh: 她的话含糊不清，很难听懂。

examples.text_en: His myopia makes it hard to see the road.
examples.text_zh: 他的近视使他很难看清道路。

examples.text_en: Myopia is common among young people today.
examples.text_zh: 如今近视在年轻人中很常见。

examples.text_en: The myopic boy could not see the far wall.
examples.text_zh: 那个近视的男孩看不清远处的墙。

examples.text_en: His myopic view of the world is a problem.
examples.text_zh: 他对世界的短浅看法是个问题。

examples.text_en: There are a myriad of stars above the world.
examples.text_zh: 世界之上有无数颗星星。

examples.text_en: She had a myriad of things to do that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天她有无数的事情要做。

examples.text_en: The old man had a mystic power over them.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人对他们有一种神秘的力量。

examples.text_en: She loved the mystic songs of her own country.
examples.text_zh: 她喜爱自己国家的神秘歌曲。

examples.text_en: The story is about a mythical king and his son.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事讲的是一个神话中的国王和他的儿子。

examples.text_en: That mythical place is not in the real world.
examples.text_zh: 那个虚构的地方不在现实世界里。

examples.text_en: That night was the nadir of his whole life.
examples.text_zh: 那一夜是他一生中的最低点。

examples.text_en: The team was at its nadir after the last game.
examples.text_zh: 上一场比赛后，这支队伍跌到了最低点。

examples.text_en: Her naivety was clear to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她的天真烂漫，全组人都看得出来。

examples.text_en: He loved the naivety of the young children.
examples.text_zh: 他喜爱那些小孩子的天真。

examples.text_en: Only one person can help, namely his own brother.
examples.text_zh: 只有一个人能帮忙，那就是他自己的兄弟。

examples.text_en: We need one thing, namely more time and money.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一样东西，即更多的时间和钱。

examples.text_en: They gave him a narcotic to stop the pain.
examples.text_zh: 他们给他用了镇静剂来止痛。

examples.text_en: This narcotic is not safe for young children.
examples.text_zh: 这种麻醉药对小孩不安全。

examples.text_en: She will narrate the story to the children.
examples.text_zh: 她将给孩子们讲述这个故事。

examples.text_en: He can narrate the whole night without a book.
examples.text_zh: 他不用书也能讲一整晚。

examples.text_en: His narration of the event was clear and simple.
examples.text_zh: 他对这件事的叙述清楚而简单。

examples.text_en: The narration of this film is read by a woman.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影的旁白由一位女性朗读。

examples.text_en: Her narrative of the war was very long.
examples.text_zh: 她关于那场战争的叙述很长。

examples.text_en: This book tells its narrative in a simple way.
examples.text_zh: 这本书用简单的方式讲述它的故事。

examples.text_en: The narrator told the story in a low voice.
examples.text_zh: 讲述者用低沉的声音讲了那个故事。

examples.text_en: Who is the narrator of this long book?
examples.text_zh: 这本厚书的讲述者是谁？

examples.text_en: His nasal voice was hard to listen to.
examples.text_zh: 他的鼻音让人很难听下去。

examples.text_en: She has a nasal sound in her own voice.
examples.text_zh: 她自己的嗓音里带着鼻音。

examples.text_en: The nascent group met for the first time.
examples.text_zh: 这个初生的团体第一次聚会。

examples.text_en: We must help this nascent idea find its way.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须帮助这个初生的想法找到自己的路。

examples.text_en: She went back to her natal town last year.
examples.text_zh: 去年她回到了自己出生的城镇。

examples.text_en: His natal home is far from this city.
examples.text_zh: 他出生的家离这座城市很远。

examples.text_en: Natation is a good way to stay strong.
examples.text_zh: 游泳是保持强壮的好方法。

examples.text_en: He learned natation in the deep water there.
examples.text_zh: 他在那里的深水里学会了游泳。

examples.text_en: People of many nationalities live in this city.
examples.text_zh: 许多不同国籍的人住在这座城市。

examples.text_en: The school has children of all nationalities.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校有各个民族的儿童。

examples.text_en: The new law is nationwide and starts today.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律是全国性的，从今天开始。

examples.text_en: There was a nationwide call for more help.
examples.text_zh: 全国上下都呼吁给予更多帮助。

examples.text_en: He is a natty man with a good job.
examples.text_zh: 他是个衣着整洁、有好工作的人。

examples.text_en: Her natty little room was full of light.
examples.text_zh: 她那间整洁的小屋充满了光。

examples.text_en: The naturalist walked through the long green fields.
examples.text_zh: 这位自然主义者走过长长的绿色田野。

examples.text_en: A naturalist studies the life of the world.
examples.text_zh: 自然主义者研究世界上的生命。

examples.text_en: The film has a naturalistic style and no music.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影风格自然，没有配乐。

examples.text_en: Her naturalistic view of the world was clear.
examples.text_zh: 她对世界的自然主义看法很清晰。

examples.text_en: The water was bad and brought her nausea.
examples.text_zh: 水坏了，弄得她一阵恶心。

examples.text_en: He felt nausea and could not eat that day.
examples.text_zh: 他感到恶心，那天什么都吃不下。

examples.text_en: The old food can nauseate the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 这些变质的食物会让整群人都作呕。

examples.text_en: Such talk will nauseate most young people today.
examples.text_zh: 这样的话会让如今大多数年轻人反感。

examples.text_en: The old man told us a nautical story.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人给我们讲了一个航海故事。

examples.text_en: This book is about nautical life and the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这本书讲的是海上生活和海洋。

examples.text_en: The naval group was near the small town.
examples.text_zh: 那支海军队伍就在小镇附近。

examples.text_en: He gave his whole life to the naval service.
examples.text_zh: 他把一生都献给了海军。

examples.text_en: The nave of the old church was full.
examples.text_zh: 那座老教堂的中殿里挤满了人。

examples.text_en: They walked through the nave to the front door.
examples.text_zh: 他们穿过中殿，走向前门。

examples.text_en: The water is navigable in the summer months.
examples.text_zh: 这片水域在夏季的几个月里可以通航。

examples.text_en: The old law says the water must stay navigable.
examples.text_zh: 旧法律规定这片水域必须保持通航。

examples.text_en: He will naysay every plan that we offer.
examples.text_zh: 我们提出的每个计划他都会反对。

examples.text_en: You cannot naysay the facts of this case.
examples.text_zh: 你无法否认这个案子的事实。

examples.text_en: The naysayer said no to every new idea.
examples.text_zh: 那个唱反调的人对每个新想法都说不行。

examples.text_en: Do not let a naysayer stop your good work.
examples.text_zh: 别让爱唱反调的人妨碍你的好工作。

examples.text_en: The nebula is far above our own world.
examples.text_zh: 那片星云远在我们的世界之上。

examples.text_en: They found a nebula in the dark night air.
examples.text_zh: 他们在漆黑的夜空里发现了一片星云。

examples.text_en: His nebulous plan was hard to understand.
examples.text_zh: 他那模糊的计划很难理解。

examples.text_en: The whole idea stayed nebulous for a long time.
examples.text_zh: 整个想法很长时间都很朦胧。

examples.text_en: The bad news will necessitate a new plan.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息将迫使人们制定新计划。

examples.text_en: This problem may necessitate more time and money.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题可能需要更多时间和金钱。

examples.text_en: The necessitous family had no food that week.
examples.text_zh: 那一周，这个贫困的家庭没有食物。

examples.text_en: He gave his money to help necessitous people.
examples.text_zh: 他捐出钱来帮助穷困的人。

examples.text_en: They found an old necropolis near the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们在城市附近发现了一处古老的大墓地。

examples.text_en: The necropolis was full of old walls and earth.
examples.text_zh: 那片大墓地里满是古老的围墙和泥土。

examples.text_en: She does fine needlework in the low light.
examples.text_zh: 她在微光下做精致的刺绣。

examples.text_en: Her needlework was the best in the whole school.
examples.text_zh: 她的刺绣是全校最好的。

examples.text_en: The needy children need food and a good home.
examples.text_zh: 贫困的孩子们需要食物和一个好家。

examples.text_en: We must give more help to needy families.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须给贫困家庭更多帮助。

examples.text_en: The nefarious plan was kept in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 这个恶毒的计划一直被藏着。

examples.text_en: He was known for his nefarious work.
examples.text_zh: 他因做坏事而出了名。

examples.text_en: One small fact can negate the whole story.
examples.text_zh: 一个小事实就能否定整个故事。

examples.text_en: He tried to negate the words of his friend.
examples.text_zh: 他试图否认他朋友说的话。

examples.text_en: Her answer was a clear negation of the idea.
examples.text_zh: 她的回答是对这个想法的明确否定。

examples.text_en: The negation of that fact is simply not true.
examples.text_zh: 对那个事实的否定根本不是真的。

examples.text_en: The fire was caused by the negligence of one man.
examples.text_zh: 这场火灾是由一个人的疏忽引起的。

examples.text_en: His negligence cost the company a lot of money.
examples.text_zh: 他的疏忽让公司损失了很多钱。

examples.text_en: The negligent man left the front door open.
examples.text_zh: 那个粗心的男人让前门开着。

examples.text_en: She was negligent and lost the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 她一时疏忽，把整样东西都弄丢了。

examples.text_en: The change was negligible and no one cared.
examples.text_zh: 变化微乎其微，没人在意。

examples.text_en: His help was negligible in the whole project.
examples.text_zh: 在整个项目里，他的帮助微不足道。

examples.text_en: The price is negotiable if you pay today.
examples.text_zh: 如果你今天付款，价格可以商量。

examples.text_en: That road is negotiable in this part of the year.
examples.text_zh: 那条路在一年中的这段时间可以通行。

examples.text_en: They will negotiate a new deal next week.
examples.text_zh: 他们下周将商议一笔新交易。

examples.text_en: We need to negotiate the price of this house.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要商量这栋房子的价格。

examples.text_en: The negro man fought well in that old war.
examples.text_zh: 那位黑人在那场旧战争里英勇作战。

examples.text_en: A negro woman told us her own story.
examples.text_zh: 一位黑人女性给我们讲了她自己的故事。

examples.text_en: We walk around the neighbourhood every morning.
examples.text_zh: 我们每天早上都在附近一带散步。

examples.text_en: This neighbourhood is full of old houses and good people.
examples.text_zh: 这一带到处都是老房子和好人。

examples.text_en: The old king was his nemesis in the end.
examples.text_zh: 到最后，那位老国王成了他的报应。

examples.text_en: He saw her as the nemesis of his own life.
examples.text_zh: 他把她看作自己命中的克星。

examples.text_en: The neoclassical house was built many years ago.
examples.text_zh: 这座新古典主义的房子建于许多年前。

examples.text_en: She loves the neoclassical style of that period.
examples.text_zh: 她喜爱那个时期的新古典主义风格。

examples.text_en: They found neolithic walls near the old town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老城附近发现了新石器时代的墙。

examples.text_en: The neolithic age came before our own time.
examples.text_zh: 新石器时代远在我们的时代之前。

examples.text_en: This neologism is new and still not common.
examples.text_zh: 这个新词还很新，尚不常见。

examples.text_en: Every year young people make a new neologism.
examples.text_zh: 每年年轻人都会造出一个新词。

examples.text_en: The neon light was red above the door.
examples.text_zh: 门上方的氖灯是红色的。

examples.text_en: They put a new neon light in the small room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在小房间里装了一盏新的氖灯。

examples.text_en: The neonate slept in a small bed all day.
examples.text_zh: 这个婴儿整天睡在一张小床上。

examples.text_en: A neonate needs food and a lot of sleep.
examples.text_zh: 婴儿需要食物和大量的睡眠。

examples.text_en: The neophyte asked many questions on the first day.
examples.text_zh: 这位新信徒第一天问了许多问题。

examples.text_en: Every neophyte must learn the old ways.
examples.text_zh: 每个新信徒都必须学会那些老规矩。

examples.text_en: The boy had nephritis and stayed in bed.
examples.text_zh: 那个男孩得了肾炎，卧床休养。

examples.text_en: Nephritis can be a serious problem for children.
examples.text_zh: 肾炎对孩子来说可能是个严重的问题。

examples.text_en: The children nestle close to their mother at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里孩子们依偎在妈妈身边。

examples.text_en: She will nestle in the big bed all morning.
examples.text_zh: 她会整个上午都窝在大床上。

examples.text_en: The small nestling stayed close to its mother.
examples.text_zh: 这只小雏鸟紧挨着它的妈妈。

examples.text_en: A nestling needs food from its mother each day.
examples.text_zh: 雏鸟每天都要靠妈妈喂食。

examples.text_en: They found the key in the nethermost room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在最下面的房间里找到了钥匙。

examples.text_en: The nethermost part of the house was dark.
examples.text_zh: 房子最下面的那部分很暗。

examples.text_en: The men took their nets out of the water.
examples.text_zh: 男人们把网从水里捞了出来。

examples.text_en: Their old nets were full and hard to hold.
examples.text_zh: 他们的旧网满满的，很难拉动。

examples.text_en: The nettle can give you a bad pain.
examples.text_zh: 荨麻会给你带来一阵剧痛。

examples.text_en: There is a nettle near the front door.
examples.text_zh: 前门旁边有一株荨麻。

examples.text_en: He studies neurology at a large university.
examples.text_zh: 他在一所大型大学里研究神经病学。

examples.text_en: Neurology is a hard field of modern science.
examples.text_zh: 神经病学是现代科学中一个艰深的领域。

examples.text_en: Each neuron has a part in our whole body.
examples.text_zh: 每个神经细胞都在我们全身起作用。

examples.text_en: This neuron is not the same as that one.
examples.text_zh: 这个神经细胞和那个不一样。

examples.text_en: His neurosis made the small things seem huge.
examples.text_zh: 他的神经症让小事显得天大。

examples.text_en: They said her neurosis was not too serious.
examples.text_zh: 他们说她这种神经症不太严重。

examples.text_en: The neurotic man could not sleep at night.
examples.text_zh: 那个神经症患者夜里睡不着。

examples.text_en: They called her a neurotic in front of us.
examples.text_zh: 他们当着我们的面叫她神经症患者。

examples.text_en: This neurotransmitter helps our body work well.
examples.text_zh: 这种神经递质有助于我们的身体正常运转。

examples.text_en: A neurotransmitter is a small part of our body.
examples.text_zh: 神经递质是我们身体的一小部分。

examples.text_en: The new law will neutralize their strong power.
examples.text_zh: 新法律将抵消他们强大的势力。

examples.text_en: They tried to neutralize the words of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图抵消那个团体的言论。

examples.text_en: They used a neutron in the first test.
examples.text_zh: 他们在第一次试验中用了中子。

examples.text_en: A neutron can pass through a wall of lead.
examples.text_zh: 中子可以穿过铅墙。

examples.text_en: He bought a paper at the newsstand today.
examples.text_zh: 他今天在报摊买了一份报纸。

examples.text_en: The newsstand near the school was still open.
examples.text_zh: 学校旁边的报摊还开着。

examples.text_en: There is a strong nexus between the two.
examples.text_zh: 两者之间有着牢固的联系。

examples.text_en: The nexus of these ideas is hard to see.
examples.text_zh: 这些想法之间的联系很难看清。

examples.text_en: This nib is not good, so we need a new one.
examples.text_zh: 这个笔尖不好，我们需要换一个新的。

examples.text_en: He had a new nib for his writing work.
examples.text_zh: 他为写作准备了一个新笔尖。

examples.text_en: The little child will nibble on the food.
examples.text_zh: 小孩会一点点地咬着吃食物。

examples.text_en: They nibble a small piece and then stop.
examples.text_zh: 他们啃了一小口，然后就停下了。

examples.text_en: He did not care for the nicety of the words.
examples.text_zh: 他并不在意用词的精细。

examples.text_en: The nicety of her work was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 她作品的精致大家都看得出来。

examples.text_en: He gave the boy a nickel for the paper.
examples.text_zh: 他给男孩一枚镍币买报纸。

examples.text_en: This box is made of nickel and lead.
examples.text_zh: 这个盒子是用镍和铅做的。

examples.text_en: The old niggard would not give them money.
examples.text_zh: 那个老吝啬鬼不肯给他们钱。

examples.text_en: They called him a niggard and left the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们骂他是吝啬鬼，然后离开了房子。

examples.text_en: We must not care about these niggling things.
examples.text_zh: 我们不必在意这些琐碎的小事。

examples.text_en: A niggling problem stayed in his mind all day.
examples.text_zh: 一个琐碎的问题在他脑海里萦绕了一整天。

examples.text_en: His nihilism made him question the whole world.
examples.text_zh: 他的虚无主义使他质疑整个世界。

examples.text_en: Nihilism is a hard idea for young people.
examples.text_zh: 虚无主义对年轻人来说是个艰深的想法。

examples.text_en: The team won by three goals to nil.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍以三比零获胜。

examples.text_en: Our hope of a win was almost nil.
examples.text_zh: 我们获胜的希望几乎为零。

examples.text_en: She was the ninth person to ask that.
examples.text_zh: 她是第九个问那个问题的人。

examples.text_en: This is the ninth day of the long month.
examples.text_zh: 这是这个漫长月份里的第九天。

examples.text_en: He used the nippers to cut the small card.
examples.text_zh: 他用钳子剪那张小卡片。

examples.text_en: Where are the nippers for this old work?
examples.text_zh: 干这个活儿用的钳子在哪儿？

examples.text_en: The nipping air made the whole group go home.
examples.text_zh: 刺骨的寒风让整群人回了家。

examples.text_en: There was nipping air near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 海边有一股刺骨的寒气。

examples.text_en: Do not nitpick every small thing we say.
examples.text_zh: 不要对我们说的每件小事都吹毛求疵。

examples.text_en: She will nitpick the work of the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她会挑剔整组人的工作。

examples.text_en: Please write your no. at the top of the page.
examples.text_zh: 请把你的号码写在页面顶端。

examples.text_en: He asked for my no. and my home town.
examples.text_zh: 他问了我的号码和家乡。

examples.text_en: The nobility lived in the big house near the city.
examples.text_zh: 贵族们住在城市附近的大房子里。

examples.text_en: He showed true nobility in the face of pain.
examples.text_zh: 面对痛苦，他表现出真正的高尚。

examples.text_en: His nocturnal work kept the whole family up.
examples.text_zh: 他夜里工作，让全家人都没法睡。

examples.text_en: Many nocturnal things can see in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 许多夜行的生物能在黑暗中看见东西。

examples.text_en: The children played noisily in the small room.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们在小房间里吵闹地玩着。

examples.text_en: He noisily opened the door and walked in.
examples.text_zh: 他吵闹地推开门走了进来。

examples.text_en: A noisome air came from the old room.
examples.text_zh: 从那间旧屋子里飘出难闻的气味。

examples.text_en: The noisome food was left out all night.
examples.text_zh: 那些难闻的食物在外面放了一整夜。

examples.text_en: The nomadic people moved from place to place.
examples.text_zh: 这些游牧的人从一个地方迁到另一个地方。

examples.text_en: They lived a nomadic life for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们过了许多年游牧的生活。

examples.text_en: The nominee gave a short talk to the group.
examples.text_zh: 被提名者向众人做了简短的发言。

examples.text_en: Who is the nominee for this important job?
examples.text_zh: 这个重要职位的被提名者是谁？

examples.text_en: My father is a non-drinker and stays that way.
examples.text_zh: 我父亲不喝酒，一直如此。

examples.text_en: She is a non-drinker and she likes it that way.
examples.text_zh: 她滴酒不沾，也乐意如此。

examples.text_en: His nonchalance did not help the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他的无动于衷对大家没有帮助。

examples.text_en: She showed nonchalance about the whole problem.
examples.text_zh: 她对整个问题表现出冷淡。

examples.text_en: He was nonchalant about the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个坏消息无动于衷。

examples.text_en: Her nonchalant words made him feel lost.
examples.text_zh: 她冷淡的话语让他感到茫然。
